However, the tutorial names abstract actions ('Hold focus', 'Hold fire') without displaying the actual controller buttons or keys, and subtitle spacing errors ('nextchallenge', 'fourdirections', 'Pleaseprotect', 'torelease', 'theproblemsare') remain frequent.","uncertainties":["Which physical keys or buttons correspond to 'focus' and 'fire'."],"minimal_fix":"Display explicit input button/key prompts next to action terms ('Focus [Shift/LB]', 'Fire [Space/RT]') and fix subtitle word spacing."},{"id":"H","ordered_observations":[{"start_s":0,"end_s":7,"account":"Narrow vertical crop of the Hangar 'Loadout' list showing 'EQUIPPED' and 'BEYOND THIS SLICE' sections, with 'Weapon package' highlighted.","threat_origin":"None (menu screen).","action_response":"Static highlight on 'Weapon package: Lane Authority Standard'.","goal_resource_change":"None; right-hand stat details panel is absent in this narrow layout.","uncertainty":"Whether the right-hand stats panel is cropped out or hidden in a narrow-aspect mode."},{"start_s":8,"end_s":15,"account":"Selection highlight moves down to 'Sensor package: Lane Authority Standard'.","threat_origin":"None.","action_response":"User moves selection down one row at 00:08.","goal_resource_change":"None visible; no stat breakdown appears.","uncertainty":"How a player inspects package stats in this single-column view."}],"heard":[],"readable_text":[{"at_s":1,"text":"EQUIPPED / Weapon package: Lane Authority Standard"},{"at_s":9,"text":"Sensor package: Lane Authority Standard"},{"at_s":12,"text":"BEYOND THIS SLICE / Injunction / Witness / Utility slot / Reactor mod / Drone bay / Hull plating"}],"simultaneous_information":[],"ratings":{"detection":null,"cause_attribution":4,"text_legibility":5,"audio_source_identification":null,"recoverability":null},"rating_evidence":"Text contrast and focus states are clean and readable at native presentation scale. However, unlike Sequence F, selecting 'Weapon package' or 'Sensor package' here displays no stat breakdown or description panel.","uncertainties":["Whether this narrow 466x800 frame is a mobile/vertical layout or a cropped capture missing the right-hand inspector panel."],"minimal_fix":"Ensure the narrow/vertical layout displays an inline or bottom-docked stat summary when cycling equipment packages."}],"cross_clip_summary":"Across gameplay sequences (A–E), high-contrast pink/yellow projectiles and distinct enemy shapes support strong threat detection, and the isolated tutorial (G) clearly teaches the central hitbox gem and focus ring. However, divided attention breaks down under three systemic flaws: (1) unqueued audio where Onboarding Assistant and radio voices ('Lane Control', 'Scout Channel') talk directly over each other (B at 00:27, C at 00:11 and 00:20); (2) spatial scattering of text across four zones (bottom subtitles, top-center Codex banners, mid-left radio toasts, and in-world scan labels over active bullets); and (3) a pervasive text-rendering bug that strips spaces between words in subtitles across all action clips."}
